review_type: independent fixed-revision source/reference review, regenerated-table audit, native image inspection (including zoomed Arabic crops) and CI status check
verdict: Run 24 is a real step forward. GStreamer and HereLink video now play behind the HUD through a faithful port of LookForGstreamer, SetGSTPath, DownloadGStreamer and the appsink loop, which closes most of round 23's priority-3 video gap. Quick view captions follow GetNameandUnit with the original L10NU tables. The four localization defects round 23 named are gone from the regenerated tables: ja '0' to '5', the zh-Hans PLAN Loiter, ko-KR Load File, and literal '&' mnemonics. Labels no longer translate data from the shared map. The per-view rework introduced two visible regressions, though. Tab strips resolve the caller inside a closure in theme.rs, so they never see view tables, and the zh-Hans DATA 'Actions' tab is English again where the original shows 动作. Arabic text that mixes in Latin or digits is drawn reversed ('mk 0059.0', 'LMK'). Gimbal video, plugins, mobile runtime and native transports are still open, and the reviewed HEAD has no CI.

scores.scale: Qualitative exact-original parity scores, not completion percentages. Overall equally weights UI/UX and features (8.9). Features credits working GStreamer/HereLink HUD video verified against a real runtime. UI/UX credits the closed localization defects, Quick view L10NU captions and the PLAN distance overlay. It is held back by the new tab-strip and Arabic bidi regressions and by the stale per-English residue inside views.

new_regression_findings.area: Tab strips lose their view's resources (#[track_caller] does not cross closures)
new_regression_findings.finding: tab_strip and tab_strip_multiline are #[track_caller], but they call i18n::t from inside `labels.iter().map(|l| crate::i18n::t(l))`. Closures do not inherit the caller location, so Location::caller() is theme.rs, views_for returns no views, and only the unanimous shared map applies. Any tab label whose translation differs across .resx files reverts to English. zh-Hans DATA 'Actions' is English in render 58, though FlightData.zh-Hans.resx:295-296 gives tabActions 动作, and round 23's render had it translated. Every tab strip in the app is affected the same way.

In the ar culture, strings that mix Arabic with Latin letters or digits render with the LTR runs reversed character by character. The PLAN distance overlay shows 'mk 0059.0 :المسافة' for 0.9500 km, and View KML shows 'عرض LMK'. WinForms/GDI applies the Unicode bidi algorithm, so the original shows 'المسافة: 0.9500 km' with the number and unit intact. The app has no bidi handling (no reordering in fonts.rs, i18n.rs or theme.rs). This was first observable this round, since round 23 had no Arabic render. Any ar label with a number, unit, acronym or format value is affected.

new_regression_findings_limit: Both are confirmed by render and source. The tab issue affects only keys that are ambiguous across .resx files (20 in zh-Hans, 39 in ko-KR overall, not all of them tabs). Not an exhaustive defect list.

ten_out_of_ten_criterion: An honest 10 requires no known material software discrepancy within the promised exact-clone scope, plus adequate interaction and native-platform evidence. Run 24 closes HUD GStreamer/HereLink video, Quick view captions, the PLAN overlay and round 23's localization defects. It adds two visible localization regressions (tab strips, Arabic bidi), and gimbal video, plugins, mobile runtime, native transports and CI on the reviewed HEAD remain open. Physical flight qualification is separate from this software parity score.
